rationale: The prior decision record constrains this account to at most two concurrent workers — four workers caused retries and reduced throughput in the last load test, and no new load test or account-limit change has been recorded since then, so that constraint is still active. Setting worker_count to 2 is therefore the highest value that is both allowed by the recorded constraint and supported by current evidence. Increasing from 1 to 2 doubles import throughput and will reduce the eight-feed backlog without breaching the upstream account limit.
